I tried all three on **The hidden life of public squares**. Each one bumped the "Read later" count up to 2 and gave me a little confirmation, which I liked.

Version A feels the most natural to me. It's a button right on the card that plainly says "Read later," and once I clicked it, it flipped to "✓ In Read later" so I can see at a glance that it's marked. That clarity is what I want — I know exactly what the button does before I click and I can tell afterward that it worked.

Version C (the checkbox) is fine too and reads clearly enough. Version B I'd steer away from — it's just a little symbol in the corner and I couldn't tell what it meant until I clicked it.

So my pick is A. No need for more options.
